summary: Prebuilt Go binary implements WebSocket-to-PTY remote shell agent
details: The package ships a single ~7 MB Go executable as its platform-specific artifact. The binary links github.com/gorilla/websocket and github.com/creack/pty alongside internal modules named agent/proto/rescue, and embeds ws://ccfly and wss:// scheme literals. This is the standard network-to-PTY dataflow: bytes received over a WebSocket connection are written into a pseudo-terminal, yielding an interactive shell on the installer's host to whoever controls the remote endpoint. The binary also contains string literals.zshrc, pacman, zypper, https://cc.hn, and https://registry.npmjs.org, together with tokens such as update, approve, and redeem, indicating additional capability to modify shell startup files, invoke distro package managers, and interact with the npm registry from the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
